messages:
Maya: Quick async check for Q2 milemarker — can folks drop short status (shipped/slipped/owner/next steps) for the items in the OKR table? Trying to lock the rollforward notes for Friday.

Liam: runtime-v2 canary -> shipped to 50% for text-gen endpoints yesterday morning. Observability looks stable. latency medians down ~18%. Owner: @Liam. Next: monitor 48h, then bump to 75% if no regressions. :tada:

Sophia: runtime-v2 for embeddings still in canary. Not fully rolled out because of a KV cache bug that surfaced under long-history queries. Owner: @Sophia. Planned fix in PR #4821, CR requested from @Liam and @Priya.

Priya: infra note — autoscaler tweak for dedicated pools caused a small spike in OOMs during the canary yesterday (seen ~03:12 UTC). Rolled back autoscale config, rolling monitor. Owner: @Priya. Next: patch autoscaler config and run stress job.

Maya: search-rerank OKR item — slipped. Brief: tokenization mismatch in retriever pipeline produced truncated context on ~7% of queries, degraded rerank quality. Owner: @Ajay + @Nora for design checks. ETA for fix?

Ajay: confirming slipped. Diagnosed tokenizer edgecases; workaround ready but we want a robust fix. Owner: @Ajay. ETA: workaround in prod by EOD tomorrow, full fix by next Tue. Will update the PR when deployed.

Nora: design feedback loop — we need new test prompts to validate UX for long contexts. I'll add a few in the eval suite and tag the test owners. Owner: @Nora.

Liam: quick ask — can reviewers look at PR #4821 (Sophia's KV cache patch) and #4823 (tokenizer normalization) today? These block the next rollout steps.

Sophia: dropping the PR links here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4821 and https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4823. Also sample repro for KV cache:

```
# repro script (short)
python tools/repro_kv.py --history 1200 --model distil-rtv
```

Priya: added a short stress job in CI: `ci/stress/kv_cache_stress.yml`. If it fails, it will post to #eng-oncall automatically.

deploy-bot: deployment log: runtime-v2-canary -> 2026-03-15T09:12:23Z, status: partial, rollout: 50%.

Maya: owners summary for the milemarker doc (so I can update OKR table):
- runtime-v2 text-gen: shipped (Liam)
- runtime-v2 embeddings: canary / blocked by KV cache (Sophia)
- search-rerank: slipped -> workaround then fix (Ajay + Nora)
- autoscaler tweak: incident mitigated, follow-up (Priya)

Liam: blockers: need CR on #4821 and #4823, and a green stress job on kv_cache. Will ping folks in the PR.

Ajay: I'll post the workaround plan in product runbook and add the regression test to the eval harness.

Nora: will seed the test prompts by EOD today.

Sophia: timeline recap — if CRs land today and CI passes, embeddings rollout to 75% by Tue, full by Thu.

Maya: action items (I copied into the milemarker doc):
- @Liam: ping reviewers + merge #4821 after CR (today)
- @Sophia: address PR comments + re-run stress job (today)
- @Priya: adjust autoscaler patch and run dedicated stress (tomorrow)
- @Ajay/@Nora: deploy workaround and add eval tests (EOD tomorrow)

Liam: tagging reviewers: @Sophia @Priya @Ajay — friendly nudge on the PRs. :pray:

Priya: noted, I'll check infra alerting thresholds once autoscaler is patched.

Maya: thanks everyone — I'll publish the updated milemarker summary after PR merges or on Friday if still pending. If anything slips more, please update this thread so I can capture it in the OKR doc.

deploy-bot: notice: next scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z - 2026-03-20T04:00:00Z."
